title: Muon-detected Big Void to be excavated in 2026 with Ministry approval

tellings.quote: the position of the big void that they're actually going to be excavating into the Great Pyramid in 2026 to investigate the big void.

plain: Inside the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt there is a large empty space, called the Big Void, found by tracking muons, tiny particles from space that pass through rock. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum says it is to be dug into in 2026 by the ScanPyramids team, a scanning project, with the approval of Egypt's Ministry of Antiquities, the government office in charge of ancient sites. He gives no source beyond naming those groups, and he presents it as the moment the hidden space would finally be opened and checked.
